shared_elements: carved/incised linear motifs on a stone surface
justification: Both surfaces bear reductive incised/relief linear motifs, including arcs and elongated strokes, but that is a generic correspondence: A shows irregular, scattered curvilinear signs, hollows and cupmarks with no organising centre, while B is a strictly radial composition of ribs converging on a central boss containing a small schematic figure or emblem. There is no shared specific motif, no shared relationship between elements, and the arrangements (dispersed vs. centred-radial) are fundamentally opposed.
